correctness.rationale: For a quadratic field extension, the trace-algebra axiom and the rank of the F-linear map give an exhaustive dichotomy: rank two forces multiplication by t(1), while rank one forces the image to be F and hence gives an arbitrary nonzero functional E→F. The classical trace-pairing criterion then shows that the source's Tr(cx) parametrization is exhaustive exactly in the separable case and collapses to zero in the inseparable case.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The field-trace separability criterion is classical prior art. Targeted searches found no public correction to arXiv:2609.19797v1 identifying the missing inseparable family or giving the corrected quadratic trace-map classification.

value.rationale: The result repairs an advertised arbitrary-field classification, replaces the failed family by an exact exhaustive parameter space, supplies a concrete tr-prime counterexample, and isolates separability as the sharp hypothesis while preserving the finite-field scope of the later results.
